item.title: Harshita Mor’s Dramatic Fall Seals Maharashtra Kesari’s 5–4 Win Over UP Dominators in PWL 2026
item.description: Harshita Mor produced a match-winning fall in the women’s 76kg bout as Maharashtra Kesari edged UP Dominators 5–4 in a thrilling Pro Wrestling League 2026 clash, moving to second place in the standings.

item.title: Gujarat Giants vs UP Warriorz Match 14, WPL 2026, Who will win today GG-W vs UPW-W match?
item.description: Gujarat Giants Women and UP Warriorz Women will be taking on each other in next game of the WPL 2026 on Thursday.

item.title: Kane's Double Sends Bayern Through In Champions League
item.description: Royale Union Saint: Harry Kane scored twice in the second half as Bayern Munich beat Royale Union Saint-Gilloise 2-0 to qualify early for the Champions League last 16, despite playing the final half-hour with 10 men.

item.title: Pakistan Left Disappointed Over Bangladesh World Cup Snub, But Will Not Consider Withdrawal
item.description: Bangladesh T20 World Cup: The International Cricket Council (ICC) decision to proceed with Bangladesh's matches in the upcoming Men's T20 World Cup in India as scheduled has been met with disappointment in Pakistan, with a former star claiming the decision was on expected lines, a news report said on Wednesday.

item.title: Barca Win In Prague To Set Up Thrilling Last Group Games In Champions League
item.description: Champions League: FC Barcelona won 4-2 away to Slavia Prague on Wednesday to keep its hopes of finishing in the Champions League top eight alive ahead of next week's final round of matches.

item.title: Afghanistan vs West Indies, 3rd T20I - Who will win today AFG vs WI match?
item.description: Afghanistan and West Indies will be up against each other for the final T20I on Thursday at Dubai International Cricket Stadium.

item.title: Aus Open: Keys Ousts Krueger; Pegula Beats Doubles Partner In All-American Second Round Matches
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Defending champion Madison Keys proved too good for Ashlyn Krueger in an all-American second-round clash at the Australian Open. The No.9 seed Keys won 6-1, 7-5 in what is her first major as defending champion.

item.title: Bangladesh Seek 48 Hours from ICC to Consult Government on Playing T20 World Cup Matches in India
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board has requested 48 hours from the ICC to consult its government on participating in the upcoming T20 World Cup in India, amid safety concerns and the risk of being replaced if they withdraw.

item.title: Aus Open: Djokovic, Musetti, Shelton Cruise Into Third Round With Easy Wins
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Former world No. 1 Novak Djokovic, Lorenzo Musetti and Ben Shelton all clinched easy straight-sets victories in their second round match of the Australian Open on the fifth day of the first Grand Slam of the season.

item.title: Varun Chakaravarthy Is A Magician, Make No Mistake: Gavaskar
item.description: Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium: Former India captain Sunil Gavaskar analysed spinner Varun Chakaravarthy’s performance and praised the team’s all-round performance in the first T20I of the five-match series against New Zealand as the Men in Blue clinched a thumping win in Nagpur and kicked off the final preparations ahead of the Men's T20 World Cup.
